transcript: No outdoor summer bash is complete without a decked out s'mores bar. I knew I wanted to make two flavors of homemade marshmallow. The first flavor is a triple vanilla bean using vanilla pods, round vanilla beans, and this powdered vanilla sugar. Next, I made a strawberry sprinkle flavor for the kids with freeze-dried strawberries that I ground until they were a fine powder and sprinkled a few spoonfuls into the same base as the vanilla marshmallows. Then I took these colorful rainbow nonpareils, spread out the strawberry marshmallow mixture, and then sprinkled them all over the top for a fun pop of color. Once the marshmallows were ready to go, I assembled the bar. I got out my massive charcuterie board, laid out chocolate and vanilla graham crackers, along with classic Hershey's chocolate bar, and a combo of dark and white chocolate for the adults. I piled the homemade marshmallows in clusters of threes, laid on some of these big roasting sticks, and voila.
metadata_caption: Triple vanilla bean or strawberry sprinkle—which homemade marshmallow belongs on your s’more? 🔥
